notes: §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 SRL3.2: "Associating the figurative constant ALL literal where the length of the literal is greater than one with a data item that is numeric or numeric edited is an obsolete feature", so at 85 it is legal, and GRL2.1 sizes the string: "repeated character by character on the right until the size of the resultant string is greater than or equal to the number of character positions in the associated data item"; a SIGN SEPARATE position "is counted in determining the size of the item" (§1985:VI.5.12.4 GR6). GateSr3/GateSr5 keep the obsolete feature silent at 85 (COBOL0902 from 2002) for MOVE (GateMove), INITIALIZE REPLACING (GateInitialize) and relations (CheckRelationalOperands); MoveEmitter.AllLiteralNumber (kb/Work PB5176 landed) gives the MOVE and INITIALIZE results; in a relation the figurative is repeated to the length of ComparisonText's temporary, which at 85 counts a SIGN SEPARATE position (OperandText.AsComparisonTemporary1985, kb/Work PB5569 landed).
